headline: TCP Invites Public Input on 20 Land Zone-Change Proposals
summary: The Town and Country Planning department has invited public feedback regarding 20 proposed zone changes. The proposals aim to convert 39,925 square metres of land under Section 39A.

headline: CM Urges Women to Report Domestic Abuse via 181 Helpline
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has urged citizens, particularly women facing domestic violence or acute emergencies, to utilize the 181 Women Helpline. He highlighted that the service is available for immediate contact during disputes.

headline: Goa IDC to Auction 50 Industrial Plots State-Wide
summary: The Goa Industrial Development Corporation is set to auction 50 industrial plots across the state. The initiative includes three plots dedicated to tech ventures at the Hello World park.

headline: NH-566 Stretch Near Dabolim Closing from October 1
summary: A section of National Highway 566 near Dabolim will be closed to traffic starting October 1. Commuters will need to use alternative routes during the closure.

headline: Rohit Monserrate to Lead Reconstituted North Goa Planning Authority
summary: The Goa government has reconstituted the North Goa Planning and Development Authority, appointing Panaji Mayor Rohit Monserrate as chairman. The authority covers Panaji, Taleigao, Bambolim, and Mapusa, with local MLAs serving as ex-officio members.

headline: Goa Govt Notifies New Fares for Tourist Taxis and Cabs
summary: The State Transport Authority has officially notified distance-based fare structures for tourist taxis and premium cabs. Rates begin at ₹300 for the first 3 kilometres for standard hatchbacks and sedans.

headline: WRD Announces ₹741-Crore Modernisation Plan for Salaulim Project
summary: The Water Resources Department has initiated a ₹741-crore project to modernize South Goa's Salaulim Irrigation System. Proposals have been invited to select a consultancy firm to prepare the Detailed Project Report.

headline: Police Caution Against Fake GSSC Job Advertisement on Social Media
summary: Goa's Cyber Crime Police Station has registered a case regarding a fraudulent recruitment notice circulating online under the Goa Staff Selection Commission's name. Authorities warned job aspirants not to fall for the fake advertisement claiming 215 vacancies.

headline: CoP Floats ₹27-Crore Tender for Panaji Port Terminal and Marina
summary: The Captain of Ports Department has invited a ₹27.04-crore Public-Private Partnership tender to operate the Panaji Port Terminal and manage surrounding jetties. The project scope also involves constructing a new yacht marina.

headline: Govt Proposes Uniform Trade Licence Fees for Village Panchayats
summary: The Goa government has drafted a standardized trade licence fee structure for village panchayats, establishing separate limits for Category A and Category B areas. Stakeholders and the public have been invited to submit their feedback within 15 days.
